labs.overview: Thread Security Labs is a hands-on cybersecurity learning and practice platform for students to apply theoretical knowledge in realistic, controlled environments.
labs.methodology: Instead of only watching lectures, students learn by doing: Learn → Discover → Analyze → Exploit → Report → Remediate.
labs.example: TS-LAB 1 SQL Injection Lab: Students are given a vulnerable web application → identify the endpoint → understand root cause → demonstrate vulnerability → document impact → implement remediation.

student_benefits: Enrolled students receive a unique TS-ID (ThreadSecurity ID).
Dashboard access is provided to all enrolled students.
The dashboard includes access to virtual labs for hands-on practice.
Students can track their enrolled courses, assessments, attendance, and academic reports directly from the dashboard.
Upon successful completion of a course, certificates can be downloaded directly from the dashboard.
enrollment_and_pricing: For all questions related to pricing, fees, and enrollment procedures, please visit our contact page at threadsecurity.in/contact.
projects: All courses include industry-based, real-world capstone projects designed to give hands-on experience before entering the job market.

industry_standards.overview: ThreadSecurity curricula are built around industry-grade tools and real-world workflows used by professionals in active AI and cybersecurity roles — not academic simulations.
learning_methodology: Project-based curriculum: every program includes a capstone real-world project.
Students work on the same tools and platforms used by industry professionals from day one.
Learning is structured around practical outcomes — not textbooks or passive theory.
Virtual labs give students hands-on access to simulated enterprise environments.
placement_readiness: Students graduate with a portfolio of real projects — not just a certificate.
Courses are designed to match current job description requirements in AI and cybersecurity roles.
The curriculum is regularly updated to reflect what employers and recruiters are actively looking for.
Students build proof-of-work — deployed systems, pentest reports, and AI applications — that can be shown directly in interviews.
ThreadSecurity prepares students for roles such as Penetration Tester, SOC Analyst, AI Engineer, ML Engineer, Data Scientist, Bug Bounty Hunter, and AI/ML Security Specialist.
industry_standards.career_outcomes: Our goal is simple: every student who completes a ThreadSecurity program should be job-ready, not just certificate-ready. The combination of mentor-led learning, real projects, and industry-standard tools means students are not starting from zero when they walk into an interview.
